facts.heading: KF564C32RSK2-32 — 32GB (16GB x 2), DDR5-6400 CL32, 288-Pin DIMM Kit
facts.source_discrepancy_note: The source heading and total-kit sentence establish 32GB as two 16GB modules. A later sentence says kit of two followed by 32GB in parentheses, which appears internally inconsistent and requires human review.
facts.module_classification_note: Consumer Kingston FURY 288-pin desktop DIMM. DDR5 on-die ECC is stated by the source and is not system ECC; non-system-ECC/unbuffered classification remains pending human review.
